41, 52, 67, 68, 68, 71, 71, 72, 73, 73, 73, 75, 76, 78, 80, 84, 84, 86, 86, 86, 86, 88, 91, 93, 95, 95, 97

Median = 78

The mode is the value that appears most often. The number 86 appears 4 times, more than any other value:

Mode = 86

The arithmetic mean of the median and mode is:

\[
\frac{78+86}{2}=\frac{164}{2}=82
\]

The answer is 82.
